highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m154 and ships compiler XML documentation with packages.
highlights_body: The release refreshes HarfBuzzSharp bindings from the bundled native source and includes upstream rendering fixes. Review the breaking changes before upgrading.

breaking.title: HarfBuzz combining-class enum member renamed
breaking.body: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 is now named CCC132 to match upstream HarfBuzz; update source code using the old member name.

breaking.title: HarfBuzz aggregate glyph flag removed
breaking.body: GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer exposed because it is an aggregate mask. Combine the concrete flags needed by your application instead.

breaking.title: RAW and DNG image decoding disabled
breaking.body: RAW and DNG images are no longer decoded by the bundled engine. Use another decoder or convert those images before loading them with SkiaSharp.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Skia m154 and incorporates upstream bug, buffer-upload, and failed-flush cache fixes.

bullets.lead: Package XML documentation now ships with the managed assemblies
bullets.detail: API documentation is authored in C# XML comments and included alongside NuGet assemblies, improving IntelliSense and offline API reference availability.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Improved native HarfBuzzSharp build warning handling

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11: Preview 2 added upstream renderer fixes, packaged compiler XML documentation, and refreshed HarfBuzzSharp bindings.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14: Release Candidate 1 disabled RAW and DNG decoding ahead of the stable release.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the HarfBuzz source pinned for the bundled native library, keeping ordinary managed types and enum values synchronized.

v4.154.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 delivers the Skia m154 renderer update and packaged compiler XML documentation.
v4.154.0.body: It includes upstream rendering fixes and refreshed HarfBuzzSharp bindings.
